composition.edit_prompt: Edit original Image A using Image B only as an unaligned rendering reference. First, lift A midtones moderately so comparable regions approach B brightness, while retaining gradual highlight separation. Second, gently increase broad tonal separation for clearer depth without halos or artificial sharpness. Make these rendering changes visible and natural. Preserve A composition, object geometry, identities and exact existing text. Do not add or remove objects, copy B textures, shift the camera or reproduce lighting differences. Keep all scene content sourced from A.

refinement.edit_prompt: Edit original Image A again, using Image B only as an unaligned rendering reference. First, make a clearly visible lift in comparable midtones so their brightness approaches B; keep highlights gradually separated and avoid washing out the image. Second, gently increase broad tonal separation without edge halos. Use natural rendering and keep shadow texture visible. Preserve A composition, object geometry, identities and exact existing text. Do not add or remove objects, copy B textures, shift the camera or reproduce lighting differences. All scene content must come from original A.
